We aim to detect repeating patterns near the top and bottom of pages.
Edge cases include section titles in the header area and split footers.
A Lightweight Method for Header/Footer Removal in Native PDFs
Our method relies on similarity across pages with tolerance to small edits.
We normalize whitespace, punctuation, and common numbering formats.
